title: Tooling: 1.27x faster t16 invoice-boundary replay via compresslevel=1 (identical receipt)
body:
## Summary

```text
registered t16 replay writes 31 mutated .gz fixtures at zlib level 9
  -> zlib.compress was 24.7 s of a 96.1 s profile
  -> compresslevel=1, decompressed payloads unchanged, receipt byte-identical
```

One-line tooling change to `research/t16-invoice-boundary-audit/verify.py`: `gzip.compress(data, mtime=0)` becomes `gzip.compress(data, mtime=0, compresslevel=1)`. Same-fixture measurements, direct registered command, stdout byte-identical on every interpreter:

| interpreter | before | after | speedup | stdout |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| CPython 3.11.15 | 174.19 s | 149.51 s | 1.17x | identical |
| CPython 3.12.13 | 107.41 s | 84.40 s | 1.27x | identical |
| CPython 3.14.4 | 67.72 s | 43.90 s | 1.54x | identical |

The verifier's own receipt comparison passes unchanged (`PASS_T16_INVOICE_BOUNDARY_AUDIT {"assembly": {"ACCEPTED": 10, "REJECTED": 16}, "cases": 54, "invoice": {"ACCEPTED": 26, "REJECTED": 28}}`), and `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/t16-invoice-boundary-audit` ends `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=completed`. No input, fixture, case, control or receipt byte changes; only the compression level of freshly written work-directory fixtures.

## Reviewer checklist

- [x] `scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/t16-invoice-boundary-audit` -> `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` (16 files at `95568ae8`).
- [x] `scripts/research_package.py --package ... --check-only` -> `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- [x] `git diff HEAD~1 --check` clean (no whitespace errors).
- [x] Direct replay passes on 3.11.15, 3.12.13 and 3.14.4 with identical stdout.
- [x] Registered replay passes on 3.12.13 through the generic runner.
- [ ] Hosted CI: the `Registered research packages` run (38939671806) is still queued; I will fix any failure it reports.

## Evidence

- Profile (cProfile, CPython 3.14.4): `zlib.compress` 24.7 s / 31 calls, `json.raw_decode` 10.8 s / 1,968 calls, vendored `invoice_allcold.recount_provider` 40.7 s cumulative / 52 calls, `fractions` ~20 s cumulative.
- This patch removes only the first item. The vendored engine is untouched; the remaining `raw_decode` cost needs the author's decision (a parsed-source cache across cases would have to respect the per-case mutation writes).
- Byte-identity policy: the repository already compares decompressed payloads rather than container bytes across Python/zlib versions ([community reproducibility audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/main/research/gzip-container-reproducibility)), so the level change does not alter any proof-relevant content.
- The package does not self-pin its own `verify.py` bytes (no MANIFEST/PINS self-check).

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. One line, removable without changing any supplier, receipt or claim. Blast radius: isolated to this package's registered replay runtime.

Convention check: many tooling PRs add a separate `research/*-fast-*` package, but direct patches to an existing package verifier with an identical receipt are also merged precedent - e.g. #2357 modifies `research/complex-center-quarter/verify.py` (with re-pinning), #2409 modifies vendored audit code and manifests, and #2100 modifies `scripts/experiments/ternary_side.py`. This package does not self-pin its own `verify.py` bytes, so no manifest update is needed. If the maintainers prefer the package form here, I can repackage the same measurement instead.

Credit: Tairitsu-Aya for the package and its 54-case mutation design. Prepared by [@kumagi](https://github.com/kumagi) with substantial AI assistance (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash in the OpenCode harness). Apache-2.0.
